reason: The first placeholder is computed using Alloyed Munitions, but FIRE_SUNDER gets getArmorSaveReduction(self,t) where t is Incendiary Ammunition. Thus displayed reduction is not reliably the applied amount when raw talent levels differ. combatTalentLimit is talent-level scaling, not Physical Power. This was observed by executor as outside original claim; host confirms within frozen target scope, no glossary/global policy change.
proposed_resolution: Qualify first placeholder as displayed value and describe actual armor/save reduction as calculated using Incendiary Ammunition talent level; remove unsupported Physical Power scaling for armor/save reduction while retaining the verified physical-damage scaling.
